features.title: Global read-only Curated Explore backed by Miniflux
features.current_task: Merged implementation is ready for main
definition_of_done: One server-only collector token resolves to a non-admin Miniflux user
Authorized users can browse shared categories, latest articles, and read-only article detail without a personal Miniflux connection
Collector read state, saved state, subscriptions, and categories are never mutated by Explore
Namespaced collector references are strictly parsed and source ownership is revalidated before Follow
Follow resolves the feed URL server-side and writes idempotently only through the current user's personal Miniflux
Me and Explore are URL-backed sibling Today views with independent state and failure handling
No Reporting feed persistence, AEAD, trending, clustering, AI summaries, webhooks, or article mirror is added
